name: Strannye prazdniki
source:
A story about two experienced pioneers living through far from their first cycle. Our pioneers set out to find a camp where it is winter instead of summer and where they celebrate the New Year, because such camps must absolutely exist!
Of course, eventually, they find it. This is the story of their adventures in a winter Sovyonok!

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3539580862]Steam[/url]]
